dialogues.speaker: Discarded Bill
dialogues.text: (A bill, carelessly discarded on the bar, one corner marked with scrawled corrections.)

dialogues.speaker: Discarded Bill
dialogues.text: "...three shipments from Liyue... very heavy... Brek's checked them..."

dialogues.speaker: Discarded Bill
dialogues.text: "...our Liyue friends have one foot on the bridge, and they could use some help..."
